battle.name: 隋攻林邑之戰
battle.brief: 大業元年正月，隋以行軍總管劉方統水陸大軍南征林邑，帥舟師出比景，二月渡闍黎江。林邑王梵志乘巨象迎戰，劉方掘坑覆草、偽北亂其陣，繼以弩射象，象驚潰，遂追奔八日至國都象林，奪廟主金像十八。羅馬弩砲並非此役裝備，但隋軍射象所用張弩、機弩與它同屬扭力蓄能的弩砲技術。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 大業元年正月，隋煬帝以中樞之命詔大將軍劉方為驩州道行軍總管，經略林邑，交戰的兩方是隋朝與占人所建的林邑國。隋軍的指揮系統分水陸兩路：欽州刺史寧長真、驩州刺史李暈與開府秦雄率步騎萬餘及配役罪人數千人由越裳出發，劉方自領大將軍張愻等以舟師出比景，兩路會於海口；後方以新平定的交州、驩州、欽州為屯糧與徵發之地，嶺南俚人降附部伍與中原南征宿軍構成兵源。林邑一方的統治以占人王國的王庭為核心，尊官有西那婆帝、薩婆地歌二職，屬官分三等，外官分為二百餘部，長官稱弗羅、次稱可輪，國王戴金花冠、衣朝霞布，良家子侍衛二百餘人各執金裝刀常侍左右；其軍事核心是象隊，巨象披甲衝撞為鋒，弓、箭、刀、槊與竹弩配合城防與野戰，都城象林及大占海口皆以磚築城、蜃灰塗壁、門朝東開。區域內還有真臘（林邑西南、本扶南屬國，《隋書》說它總大城三十）與交州俚人勢力，隋軍出兵的南方背景正是劉方剛剛平定的交州，而真臘與林邑之間亦有爭端，這些都構成本戰的周邊格局。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Sui dynasty and Lâm Ấp, the Cham kingdom on the coast of present-day central Vietnam. In the first month of the Daye era (605) Emperor Yang of Sui authorised Liu Fang, who had just pacified Jiaozhou, to serve as overall commander of the expeditionary army of the Xuanzhou circuit and to take Lin Yi. His force was organised into two columns working in concert: the military commissioner of Qin Prefecture, Ning Changzhen, the military commissioner of Xuanzhou, Li Yun, and the high official Qin Xiong led more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry together with several thousand convicted men assigned to the service, while Liu Fang took command in person of the naval squadron with general Zhang Xie and went out by way of Bǐ Cǎng; the two columns met at the river mouth. Behind them lay Jiaozhou, Xuanzhou and Qin Prefecture as sources of grain and of conscripted troops, with the southern frontier clans who had submitted to Sui and the veteran southern-expedition units forming the rank and file. On the Lâm Ấp side the state was organised around the Cham king's court: two great dignitaries called Xī Nà Pó Dì and Sà Pó Dì Gē, three ranks of dependent officials, and more than two hundred external districts whose chiefs were titled Fó Luó or Kě Lún, comparable to local magistrates. The king wore a golden flower crown and cloth of the morning-cloud pattern, and two hundred or more men of good family served as his personal guard, each holding a gold-mounted sabre. The core of its military strength was its elephants, armoured beasts used as a battering arm, supported by bows, arrows, sabres, spears and bamboo crossbows in the field and on the walls. The capital Xiàng Lín, like the great harbour town of Dà Zhàn Hǎi Kǒu, was walled in brick, plastered with shell lime and entered through gates facing east. In the wider region stood Zhèn Là, a former dependency of Fúnán lying to the south-west of Lâm Ấp, described in the History of Sui as ruling thirty large cities, together with the Tày clans of Jiaozhou; the southern background of the campaign was precisely the Jiaozhou that Liu Fang had just reduced, and there were rivalries between Zhèn Là and Lâm Ấp as well, all of which shaped the setting of the war.
people: 主導這場戰爭的是隋朝一方的將領與林邑一方的國王。隋煬帝楊廣在仁壽末、大業初更替之際批准出兵，兵部與尚書省授權劉方以行軍總管身份全權經略南征；劉方此前新平交州，選擇由海陸兩面同時壓上，這個部署本身就是他最大的貢獻。他在大軍之前先打掉林邑守險之兵，渡過闍黎江時首次接戰不利，卻沒有硬攻，而是改用掘坑覆草、挑釁偽北的辦法把象陣引入陷坑，再以弩射象，隨後以銳師繼之，一戰而破敵主力。追擊過馬援銅柱以南，八日直抵國都，四月破城刻石紀功；但他在班師途中染病，死在回程道上。屬下寧長真、李暈、秦雄各領一路步騎，張愻統舟師，行軍司馬李綱隨軍——《隋書》記劉方承接楊素之意而屈辱李綱，幾至死地，此役之後李綱久不得調，蘇威又遣他往南海接應林邑軍，終不見召。此外，被史書記為「遣兵守險」「乘巨象而戰」「棄城走入海」的是林邑王梵志；他復國之後遣使謝罪，朝貢不絕，成為此戰另一種意義上的主角。
peopleEn: The men who decided the outcome were the Sui commanders on one side and the king of Lâm Ấp on the other. Emperor Yang of Sui, newly come to the throne as the Renshou reign ended, approved the expedition, and the Ministry of War and the Department of State Affairs gave Liu Fang full authority as overall commander. Liu Fang had just pacified Jiaozhou, and his decision to press on the south by sea and by land at the same time was the single most important contribution he made to the campaign. He first destroyed the Lâm Ấp detachments posted to hold the passes, and although his first contact after crossing the Trà Kiệu river went against him, he did not throw his troops into a frontal assault. Instead he dug shallow pits, covered them with grass, provoked the enemy and then feigned a retreat, so that the elephant formation chased him into the pits, stumbled and panicked, and the Cham line broke itself. Only then did he loose crossbow bolts at the elephants, which turned and trampled their own army, after which he sent in fresh elite troops and destroyed the Cham host in a single action, taking or killing ten thousand of them. He pursued them, fought repeated engagements on the way, passed south of Ma Yuan's bronze column and reached the capital eight days later; in the fourth month the city fell, a stele was cut to record the victory, and on the road home the general fell ill and died. Under him Ning Changzhen, Li Yun and Qin Xiong led the columns of infantry and cavalry, Zhang Xie commanded the naval squadron, and Li Gang served as the army's military registrar; the History of Sui records that Liu Fang, acting on the wishes of Yang Su, humiliated Li Gang almost to the point of death, and after the campaign Li Gang was left without promotion, was sent by Su Wei to the southern sea to meet the returning army, and was never called for. The other principal figure recorded in the sources, the king who posted troops to hold the passes, fought riding on great elephants and abandoned his city for the sea, was Phạm Phật, called Fàn Fánzhì in the Chinese records. After recovering his country he sent an embassy to apologise and his tribute never ceased, which made him, in a different sense, the other protagonist of the war.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲，學名 Scorpio，是扭力蓄能的弩砲，一發一具重箭，羅馬人用它拆希臘城牆；但必須講清楚：它並不在大業元年這場戰爭的現場，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有記載隋朝或林邑使用過羅馬式弩砲。此役真正上陣的投射兵器，是隋軍的弩——「方以弩射象」一句見於《資治通鑑》卷一百八十，是破象的關鍵；中國的張弩、蹶張弩、機弩與羅馬弩砲同屬以扭力或人力蓄能的弩砲技術譜系，經中亞與草原之路東傳，與地中海的希臘扭力砲同源，只是形制與命名不同。與弩並用的還有弓、箭、刀、槊、鎗、盾與步騎的甲胄；攻守器械方面，隋軍備舟師鬥艦、雲梯與掘坑用的土工器具，林邑則以磚築城、蜃灰塗牆，城門朝東開啟，牆上以象與弓弩防守。值得注意的是《隋書·林邑傳》記林邑「以竹為弩，傅毒於矢」，即以竹製弩機、箭上淬毒，是林邑守城與野戰的主要投射手段；兵器之外，鼓與吹蠡用於警眾與發進，軍中音樂有琴、笛、琵琶、五絃。糧秣靠海運與交州後方供應，酷熱潮濕的沿海氣候造成士卒足部腫脹，也是裝備之外最要命的消耗。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scorpio, a torsion-powered bolt thrower that loosed a single heavy bolt and was used by the Romans to break Greek city walls. It has to be said plainly, however, that it was not present in this war: neither the History of Sui nor the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance records the Sui or the Cham using a Roman-type bolt thrower in 605. The missile weapon that actually decided the fighting was the Sui crossbow, and the phrase in the Comprehensive Mirror, juan 180, that Fang loosed his crossbows at the elephants is the key moment. The Chinese hand crossbows, the two-man drawn crossbows and the mounted torsion engines belong to the same family of spring-driven artillery as the Roman scorpio, having reached China over the Central Asian and steppe routes and sharing an origin with the Hellenistic torsion engines of the Mediterranean, though the frames and the names differ. Alongside the crossbows the Sui carried bows, arrows, sabres, spears, halberds, shields and the armour of the foot and the horse. For the attack and the defence they had warships, siege ladders and the earth-working tools for digging the pits; the Cham on the other side built their cities in brick, plastered the walls with shell lime, opened their gates to the east, and mounted elephants and crossbowmen on the ramparts. A striking detail in the History of Sui's biography of Lâm Ấp is that the Cham made their crossbows of bamboo and daubed their arrows with poison: bamboo bow frames and poisoned arrows were their chief means of shooting in the field and on the walls. Beyond the weapons, drums and conch shells gave the alarm and the signal to advance, and the military music of the country included the qin, the flute, the pipa and the five-stringed lute. Grain came by sea and from the depots of Jiaozhou, and the hot, wet coastal climate produced swollen feet among the troops, a consumption of manpower more lethal than any weapon in the field.
tactics: 劉方的整套打法可以分成四步。第一步是分進合擊：步騎由越裳（交趾一線）南下，舟師由比景沿海岸南行，兩路在海口會合，使林邑無法判斷主攻方向；同時以小股兵力先把林邑遣兵守險的關隘打掉，掃清渡口。第二步是渡江接戰：師渡闍黎江，林邑以巨象四面逼近，隋軍首戰不利。第三步是破象：多掘小坑、以草覆上，再以兵挑之，兩軍交鋒時隋軍偽北，林邑追擊，象群陷坑顛躓、驚駭互踏，軍陣自亂；此時方以弩射象，象受創卻走，反過來踐踏自己人，隋軍乘亂以銳師繼之，一舉而破，俘馘萬計。第四步是追擊與攻都：劉方引兵連戰皆捷，越過馬援銅柱以南的舊界，八日抵達國都，四月城破，王出奔，隋軍入城刻石紀功而還。補給線是此役最脆弱的一環：遠距離海陸並行，糧食靠船運與交州屯田，士卒在溽熱的沿海山地行軍，足部腫脫者眾，死者什四五，主將本人亦在班師途中病歿。羅馬弩砲本身並未參戰，但其形制所代表的弩砲技術，正是「以弩射象」這一步的技術內核。
tacticsEn: Liu Fang's method can be broken into four steps. First, convergence: the infantry and cavalry came south by way of Yuè Shàng, the northern Vietnamese corridor, while the naval squadron worked down the coast from Bǐ Cǎng, the two columns joining at the river mouth, so that Lâm Ấp could not tell which axis was the main one; at the same time small detachments cleared the passes where the Cham had posted troops to hold them, opening the crossings. Second, the engagement on the river: the army crossed the Trà Kiệu, the Cham came on with great elephants from every side, and the Sui's first action went against them. Third, the breaking of the elephants: Liu Fang had many small pits dug and covered them with grass, then used his men to provoke, and when the two sides engaged the Sui feigned flight; the Cham followed, the elephants fell into the pits, stumbled and startled one another, and the Cham formation came apart. At that moment Liu Fang loosed his crossbows at the elephants, which were wounded, turned and fled, trampling their own troops, and the Sui followed with fresh elite infantry to complete the rout, taking or killing ten thousand of the enemy. Fourth, pursuit and the storm of the capital: Liu Fang pressed on, won repeated engagements, passed south of Ma Yuan's bronze column and reached the capital eight days later; in the fourth month the city was taken, the king fled, the army entered, cut a stele to record its victory and turned home. Supply was the weakest link in the whole operation: a long parallel advance by sea and land, with food carried by ship and drawn from the depots of Jiaozhou, and a march through sweltering coastal hills produced so many troops with swollen feet that between one tenth and four tenths of the army died, and the commander himself died of illness on the return. The Roman scorpio did not fight here, but the technology its form represents, torsion-driven power and one heavy bolt per shot, is precisely the technical core of the step in which the crossbows were loosed at the elephants.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。兵員：《隋書·林邑傳》記劉方所統為欽州刺史寧長真、驩州刺史李暈、開府秦雄率步騎萬餘，加上配役的犯罪者數千人；舟師人數史無明文，只記劉方親率大將軍張愻等以舟師出比景。時間：正月出兵，軍至海口，二月渡闍黎江，四月破國都刻石紀功而還，全程約三至四個月。行程：無論由越裳或比景起兵，越過馬援銅柱以南後，八日即抵國都，可見先鋒推進之速。損失：《資治通鑑》記「士卒腫足，死者什四五」，即死於足疾者約佔十分之一至十分之四；主將劉方「亦得疾，卒於道」。戰果：林邑大敗，「俘馘萬計」；破城後獲其廟主十八枚，皆鑄金為之，《隋書》解釋為其國歷十八葉。此外可參考的制度數字：林邑外官分二百餘部，國王侍衛中良家子二百餘人，皆執金裝刀；都城以磚築、蜃灰塗壁；隋軍立功後在林邑故地置比景、海陰、林邑三縣，隸交州。戰前則有南朝宋檀和之、陳駱賓先後深入林邑而不能久守的舊例，可見此地城防向來不易攻取。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run as follows. Strength: the History of Sui's biography of Lâm Ấp records that Liu Fang's expedition comprised the more than ten thousand infantry and cavalry of the Qin Prefecture commissioner Ning Changzhen, the Xuanzhou commissioner Li Yun and the high official Qin Xiong, together with several thousand convicted men assigned to the service; the numbers of the naval squadron are not stated in the histories, which record only that Liu Fang took command in person with general Zhang Xie and went out by way of Bǐ Cǎng. Timing: the army left in the first month and reached the river mouth, crossed the Trà Kiệu in the second, and in the fourth month took the capital, cut its stele and turned back, the whole operation lasting roughly three to four months. Distance: whether the force started from Yuè Shàng or from Bǐ Cǎng, it was only eight days from the point south of Ma Yuan's bronze column to the capital, which shows how fast the advance moved. Losses: the Comprehensive Mirror states that the soldiers' feet swelled and one in ten to four in ten died, men perishing of foot disease amounting to roughly a tenth up to two fifths of the force, and that Liu Fang also fell ill and died on the road. Results: the Cham were routed, with ten thousand of them taken or killed; after the city fell, eighteen golden images of the temple lords were seized, all cast in gold, which the History of Sui explains as marking eighteen successive reigning houses. Supporting institutional figures: Lâm Ấp had more than two hundred external districts, and two hundred or more men of good family guarded the king, each with a gold-mounted sabre; the cities were walled in brick and plastered with shell lime; after the victory the Sui set up the three counties of Bǐ Cǎng, Hǎi Yīn and Lâm Ấp in the old territory, subordinated to Jiaozhou. For the longer run, the campaigns of the Liu Song commander Tán Héchī and the Chen commander Luò Bīn had penetrated Lâm Ấp without being able to hold it, evidence that these defences had always been hard to take.
cause: 這場戰爭不是突然爆發的。隋文帝平陳之後，林邑王一度遣使獻上地方物產，《隋書》記其後「朝貢遂絕」，雙方的正式往來中斷；到仁壽末，隋廷內部又起了「群臣言林邑多奇寶者」的風氣，宮廷對南海的珍異懷有明確的意欲，而《隋書》史臣在卷末直言「甘心遠夷，志求珍異，故師出於流求，兵加於林邑」。技術與行政上的條件也在同時成熟：劉方新平交州，驩州、欽州可以徵發兵糧，海上舟師技術自南朝以來已成熟，隋朝又能從交州、廣州沿海直接南下，於是先後以寧長真出越裳、張愻出比景，兩路夾擊北面。林邑方面的直接誘因則是邊境與朝貢的僵持：梵志既不克定期入朝，也不肯交出越裳一帶的既得利益，隋軍南下等於逼他表態；他在隋軍逼近時遣兵守險、驅象出戰，是被迫應戰而非主動挑釁。背景還有整個大業元年的南進國策：同年朝廷大興東都與運河，經營淮海，並派屯田主事常駿出使南海赤土，說明經營遠方已成為隋煬帝時期的既定方向，林邑之役只是這條線上的一次用兵。
causeEn: The war did not break out without warning. After Sui had overthrown the Chen, the king of Lâm Ấp sent an embassy with local products, and the History of Sui records that tribute then ceased, so that regular intercourse between the two states lapsed. Toward the end of the Renshou reign a fashion of talk spread at court that the officials spoke of the abundance of rare treasures in Lâm Ấp, and the palace had a clear appetite for the marvels of the southern sea; the historiographer of the History of Sui put it plainly at the end of the chapter: glad to reach the distant barbarians and in quest of rare and strange things, hence troops were sent to Liúqiú and war was waged against Lâm Ấp. The technical and administrative conditions matured at the same time: with Jiaozhou newly reduced, Xuanzhou and Qin Prefecture could supply troops and grain; naval technique had been mature since the southern dynasties; and the Sui could move straight down the coast from Jiaozhou and Guangzhou. Hence the two columns that went out by Yuè Shàng under Ning Changzhen and by Bǐ Cǎng under Zhang Xie, closing on Lâm Ấp from two directions. The immediate occasion on the Cham side was the deadlock over tribute and the frontier: Phạm Phật neither came to court at the appointed time nor surrendered his interest in the Yuè Shàng region, so the advance of the Sui army forced him to declare himself, and his posting of troops to hold the passes and his charge with elephants were a forced response rather than an aggressive move. The background was the general southern policy of the Daye era: in the same year the court built the eastern capital and the canals, worked its way through the Huai and the sea, and sent the colony superintendent Chang Jun by sea to the country of Chitu, showing that the ordering of distant regions had become settled policy under Emperor Yang, and that the war against Lâm Ấp was simply one round of shooting on that line.
impact: 短期看，隋朝在林邑取得了可以寫進銘文的勝利：王城被破，廟主金像被奪，刻石紀功的消息隨大軍一路傳回長安。但實際的統治成果極有限。劉方班師，梵志復其故地，遣使謝罪，於是朝貢不絕，隋朝在林邑故地置比景、海陰、林邑三縣、隸於交州，只是名義上的羈縻，林邑仍由本王治理。這一役真正的收穫在航道與秩序：隋廷從此打通廣州、交州至占婆海岸的航路，大業三年又派屯田主事常駿、虞部主事王君政浮海使赤土，東晉以來屢為南疆隱患的地區不再是無序之地，而真臘這類鄰國在大業十二年也遣使入貢，隋唐時期南海交通的格局由此奠定。遠期看，林邑在隋亡之後重獲獨立，隋末亂局中它並未消亡，反而在七至八世紀成為南海強國，先後與真臘、室利佛逝角力，終唐一代貢道不絕，到唐至德年間之後國號改稱「環王」。對隋朝自身，這場勝利幾乎是國運的注腳：《隋書》史臣在同一段裡直言「雖有荒外之功，無救域中之敗」，大業年間連續用兵於流求、林邑與吐谷渾，加上東都與運河的徭役，消耗的正是隋朝最後的民力，而本役因足疾而死者什四五的部隊代價，也預示了遠征軍隊在熱帶環境中的脆弱。
impactEn: In the short term the Sui won a victory that could be inscribed on stone: the royal city was taken, the golden images of the temple lords were carried off, and the news of the stele travelled back to Chang'an with the army. The practical result of rule, however, was extremely limited. Liu Fang withdrew, Phạm Phật recovered his country, sent an embassy to apologise, and tribute never ceased; the three counties of Bǐ Cǎng, Hǎi Yīn and Lâm Ấp that the Sui set up in the old territory, subordinated to Jiaozhou, were nominal control only, and Lâm Ấp went on being governed by its own king. The real gains lay in the sea route and in the order it established: from then on the Sui held open the lane running from Guangzhou and Jiaozhou to the Cham coast; in the third year of Daye the court sent the colony superintendent Chang Jun and the ministry clerk Wang Junzheng by sea to the country of Chitu; a southern frontier that had troubled the Chinese states intermittently since the Eastern Jin was no longer ungoverned; and such neighbours as Zhèn Là sent tribute in the twelfth year of Daye, so that the pattern of maritime traffic in the South Sea under the Sui and the Tang was settled here. In the long run Lâm Ấp regained its independence as the Sui collapsed; it did not disappear amid the disorder at the end of the dynasty but rose in the seventh and eighth centuries as a maritime power, contending in turn with Zhèn Là and with Śrī Lingkasī, and its road of tribute to the Chinese court ran unbroken through the Tang, until after the Zhide era the country changed its name to Huán Wáng. For the Sui itself this victory was almost a footnote on the fate of the dynasty: the historiographer of the History of Sui wrote in the same breath that though there were achievements beyond the frontier they could not save the defeats within, and the constant wars of the Daye years in Liúqiú, Lâm Ấp and Tuyuhun, together with the labour levies for the eastern capital and the canals, consumed the last strength of the Sui people; the price paid in this campaign, with one in ten to four in ten of the force dying of foot disease, likewise showed how fragile a distant expeditionary army was in a tropical climate.
result: 打完了：隋軍破象兵、破都城、獲廟主十八枚、俘馘萬計，四月刻石紀功，班師；林邑王梵志棄城入海，其後復國，遣使謝罪，朝貢不絕，隋朝所設比景、海陰、林邑三縣只留下紙面上的郡縣。代價同樣清楚：士卒腫足而死十之四五，主將劉方得疾卒於道，一次遠征折損的部隊相當可觀。從兵器的角度看，此役是一個關於弩砲的案例——正面硬撼巨象的一方反而先崩，勝方用陷坑限制象的衝程、用弩的定向射擊消耗象的載人與士氣、再用偽北把對手拉進預設地形，而不是靠更多象或更多兵力；羅馬弩砲的形制雖然不在現場，但它代表的扭力蓄能、一發一具重箭的技術，恰好是「以弩射象」那一步的原型。就此役本身而言，結論是簡單的：隋朝用一次成功的會戰把林邑打成朝貢國，卻沒有能力把林邑變成郡縣；林邑用一座空城換回了自己的國家、自己的王與延續不絕的南海航路。
resultEn: The fighting was over: the Sui army broke the elephant host, took the capital, seized eighteen golden images of the temple lords, took or killed ten thousand of the enemy, cut a stele to record the fact in the fourth month and marched home; the king of Lâm Ấp, Phạm Phật, abandoned his city for the sea, and afterwards recovered his country, sent an embassy to apologise and paid tribute without interruption, while the three counties the Sui set up remained counties on paper. The cost was equally plain: one in ten to four in ten of the soldiers died of swollen feet, and the commander Liu Fang fell ill and died on the road, so the losses of a distant expedition were substantial. In terms of weaponry the campaign is a case study in the bolt thrower. The side that tried to meet the elephants head on was the first to break, while the winners used the pits to limit the elephants' charge, used the aimed fire of the crossbow to wear down the beasts and the men riding them, and used the feigned retreat to drag the enemy into ground prepared in advance, rather than bringing up more elephants or more men. The form of the Roman scorpio was not present on the field, but the torsion-driven principle it embodied, one heavy bolt per shot, was the prototype of exactly that step in which the crossbows were loosed at the elephants. For the campaign itself the conclusion is simple: the Sui turned Lâm Ấp into a tributary state with one well-fought battle, and had no ability to turn Lâm Ấp into commanderies; Lâm Ấp traded an empty city for its own state, its own king and an unbroken lane across the South Sea.
